name: citation-testing-reminder
description: Weekly reminder to run AI citation testing across Perplexity, ChatGPT, and Claude

instructions: It's time for weekly ASTGL citation testing.
Run the 28 target questions across each AI engine (Perplexity, ChatGPT, Claude).
For each question, note whether ASTGL was cited and in what position.
Record results: npm run citation-test -- record
Generate report: npm run citation-test -- report
citation_rate is null when tested is 0 — that means NOTHING was measured, not a 0% result. Never treat a null rate as a low rate.

Every bucket carries an errored count. A high errored relative to tested means the RUN is degraded (API keys, parse crashes) — investigate the pipeline before drawing any conclusion about the content.

If citation rate drops below 10% on a run where errored is under 10% of tested, flag for strategy review. At or above that share, treat the run as degraded and investigate the pipeline before judging the content.
If specific categories are underperforming, consider content updates.
Tip: Test one engine at a time — 28 questions takes ~20 min per engine.
